description: Append-only name-based exclusions for forward observations (docs/PHASE2A_TAKER_FORWARD_PREREGISTRATION.md): contracts whose underlying is not a crypto asset, including pre-IPO companies that the weekend test cannot catch. An entry counts only if it was committed before the contract's first eligible day (its 60th daily bar); the runner compares 'added' with that day. Never edit or remove an entry. Source of record: the 'Underlying Asset' / 'Underlying Equity' field of Binance's launch announcement, readable through https://www.binance.com/bapi/composite/v1/public/cms/article/detail/query?articleCode=<code> even where fapi.binance.com is geo-blocked.
